name: Boho Group AB (publ)
summary: Boho Group AB (publ) specializes in the development and management of hotels and restaurants, with its operations spanning Spain and the wider European region. A key asset is the Boho Club, an exclusive boutique resort located on Marbella's prestigious Golden Mile, which the group both owns and manages. The company, previously known as Quartiers Properties AB (publ), adopted its current designation, Boho Group AB (publ), in September 2024. Established in 2014, its corporate headquarters are situated in Stockholm, Sweden.
